title: Storyblok Component
description: A component definition in Storyblok that specifies the content schema for a story type. Components define the available fields, their types, and validation rules used by the Storyblok editor and content API.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier of the component within the space.

name.description: Technical name and identifier of the component. Used as the value of the component field in story content.

display_name.description: Optional human-readable display name shown in the Storyblok editor, overriding the technical name.

is_root.description: True if this component can be used as the root-level component of a story.

is_nestable.description: True if this component can be nested inside blok fields of other components.

component_group_uuid.description: UUID of the component group this component belongs to, used for organization in the editor.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the component was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent modification to the component.

schema.description: Map of field names to field definition objects. Each field definition specifies the type and configuration for a content field available in stories using this component.

image.description: Optional thumbnail image URL displayed for this component in the editor.

preview_field.description: Field name used as the preview label for component instances in the editor.

icon.description: Icon identifier used for this component in the Storyblok editor interface.

color.description: Hex color code used to visually distinguish this component in the editor.

FieldDefinition.description: Definition of a single content field within a component schema.

type.description: The field type determining what content the field accepts and how it is rendered in the editor.

display_name.description: Human-readable label displayed for this field in the Storyblok editor.

required.description: True if this field must have a value before the story can be saved.

description.description: Help text displayed below the field in the editor.

default_value.description: Default value pre-populated when a new story using this component is created.

pos.description: Sort position of this field within the component schema for editor display ordering.

translatable.description: True if this field can have separate values per language in multi-language spaces.

restrict_components.description: For bloks fields: true if only specific whitelisted components can be added.

component_whitelist.description: For bloks fields with restrict_components: list of allowed component names.

options.description: For option and options fields: list of available selection choices.

source.description: For option and options fields: datasource slug to populate choices from.

datasource_slug.description: For option fields sourced from a datasource: the datasource slug to query.

max_length.description: For text and textarea fields: maximum number of characters allowed.

min_value.description: For number fields: minimum numeric value allowed.

max_value.description: For number fields: maximum numeric value allowed.

filetypes.description: For asset fields: list of allowed file type extensions.

FieldOption.description: A selectable option for option and options field types.

name.description: Display label for this option shown in the editor dropdown or checkbox list.

value.description: The actual value stored in story content when this option is selected.
